verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents a network of 53 real street addresses across 44 U.S. states, including premium locations like Park Avenue NY and Market Street SF. Setup starts with choosing an address, so users pick a location during signup. The network is described only as nationwide U.S., with no international locations, and nothing shows that capabilities can be compared per location before signing up. Missing for 10: international/multi-country locations, per-location capability details visible before signup, independent corroboration.
